prompt: Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Use Spectrum 1-10: page #1C1D16, text #F5F7F3, accent #8AE59A, secondary surface #252C37, text on accent #111111. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Libre Baskerville; direct grotesque heading with measured reading serif. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 20px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
